:::: {.contribution authors="editorial"}

This directory is generated from the original-author and substantive-contributor fields in the current articles. A Git commit does not establish authorship. Profile pages list recorded contributions and public information supplied or confirmed by the person, such as affiliation, research interests, and academic profiles. Unknown details are left empty.
